entries.name: Screenshot baseline manifest
entries.purpose: The canonical screenshot of every household- and public-facing surface, captured against a live demo household, plus the script and manifest that reproduce them. Admin and developer surfaces are not yet captured.
entries.evidence: 18 surfaces captured by PDA1 on 2026-07-11 (all public + household routes, incl. the hidden /supermarkets and /quick-meal). The inherited claim that no browser could run here was false — chromium runs once the Nix-store shared libraries are on LD_LIBRARY_PATH; see scripts/capture-product-screenshots.ts. Admin- and developer-tier surfaces remain uncaptured (they need an admin session) — that residual gap is what fnd-no-screenshot-baseline now records.

entries.name: Product Knowledge
entries.purpose: Ask what THA is or what it can do, and get an answer from this registry — permission-aware, and never a sentence invented by the Companion.
entries.evidence: PHASE5A registered `product-knowledge` in server/intelligence/capability-registry.ts and bound it (read/search/explain) — the capability PDA1 recorded as absent now exists, so `fnd-no-product-knowledge-capability` is CLOSED. Entries are filtered by visibility before prompt composition (Rule PKR26), and the filter fails closed to `developer` (Rule PKR22). Verified by server/tests/test-intelligence-product-knowledge-binding.ts (32 assertions). `fnd-pkr27-prompt-knowledge` REMAINS OPEN and is deliberately not claimed as fixed: this change gives the Companion a registry to query, but nobody has yet audited the existing system prompts, templates and fallback strings for sentences about THA that duplicate it. The second narrator is now avoidable; it has not been shown to be absent.

entries.name: Nutrition & Food Knowledge
entries.purpose: Ask about any food, nutrient, benefit or way of preparing it, and get an answer traced to a reviewed fact — never an invented one.
entries.evidence: PHASE5A extended this capability with PREPARATION KNOWLEDGE (WS5A) — how a food is cooked, preserved and prepared. The catalogue and the food↔preparation links are seeded (39 preparations, 420 links); NO preparation EFFECT is seeded, so THA currently states that a preparation exists and states nothing about what it changes. That is the honest position, not a shortfall: an effect is a health claim and passes the same Layer-2 gate as every benefit chip (cited source + named human sign-off, `npm run knowledge:signoff`).

entries.name: Apple
entries.purpose: Ask Apple about your food, your plan, your pantry or your list; it answers from what THA holds, proposes actions you must confirm, and says "I don't know" rather than guessing.
entries.cannot: Cannot place an order, cannot change anything without explicit confirmation, and cannot currently answer a single question about THA itself.
